title: Auth: JWT tokens remain valid after user logs out
description: Signing out does not invalidate the JWT on the server. Tokens retain their full 24-hour TTL after logout. An intercepted or stored token can be replayed to access the API as the original user until natural expiry. Needs server-side token blocklist or session-scoped JWTs.

audit_log.action: priority set to P0 — active security risk

title: UI: Issue table renders blank on first paint in Firefox 124
description: On Firefox 124, the issue table body is empty when the page first loads. The rows appear only after the user triggers a resize or scroll event. Reproducible 100% on Firefox 124.0.1 on macOS and Windows. Chrome 124 and Safari 17 are unaffected. Likely a rendering timing issue with the module script evaluation order.

audit_log.action: reproduced on Firefox 124.0.1 macOS and Windows

title: Refactor: Extract shared form validation logic out of individual page scripts
description: Title validation, required-field checking, and numeric range validation are copy-pasted across index.html, issue.html, and settings.html with minor variations. Extract into a validateForm(rules) helper in js/ui.js so bugs only need to be fixed once. Identified during the issue-001 security audit.

description: Power users should be able to navigate issues without a mouse. Proposed bindings: j/k to move up and down the list, Enter to open the focused issue, c to claim, a to approve. Shortcut overlay triggered by ?. Sarah is finalizing the full keybinding spec before implementation starts.

title: Bug: Pagination resets to page 1 when a status filter is applied or cleared
description: When a user is on page 3 of the issue list and applies or removes a status filter, the visible rows jump to page 1 but the URL query string still shows ?page=3. Pressing the browser back button then renders an empty table. The page state and URL are out of sync after any filter change.

audit_log.action: priority changed from P2 to P1 — reproducible in prod

title: Perf: N+1 query on GET /api/issues causes 2–4s dashboard load beyond 50 issues
description: Each issue in the list response triggers a separate SQL query to fetch its most recent audit log entry. On a dashboard with 60 issues this generates 61 sequential queries per page load. Measured at P99: 3,800ms. Needs a single JOIN query with a covering index on audit_log(issue_id, at DESC).
result: Root cause confirmed: the ORM's eager-load for audit_log entries was silently disabled in migration 0031 three weeks ago. Every call to issue.latestAuditEntry() fell back to a separate SELECT. Fix: rewrote IssueRepository.listWithLatestLog() to use a single LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT action, at FROM audit_log WHERE issue_id = issues.id ORDER BY at DESC LIMIT 1) sub query. Added composite index on audit_log(issue_id, at DESC). EXPLAIN ANALYZE on a 60-issue fixture: total query time 42ms, down from 3,800ms. PR #147 includes before/after screenshots and a regression test that asserts query count === 1 regardless of result set size.

audit_log.action: confirmed by DBA — 61 queries per page load on staging

title: Security: Rate-limit POST /api/issues to prevent runaway agent flooding
description: A misconfigured agent created 4,000 duplicate issues in 8 minutes on staging with no throttling in place. Add per-API-token rate limiting: max 20 issue creations per minute, configurable via RATE_LIMIT_RPM env var. Exceeded requests must return 429 with a Retry-After header. Limit state must be shared across API workers via Redis.
result: Implemented token-bucket rate limiter in middleware/rateLimiter.js. Limit is 20 requests/minute per API token, configurable via RATE_LIMIT_RPM. Requests exceeding the limit receive 429 with Retry-After: 60. Redis stores bucket state with a 60s TTL so limits work correctly across multiple API worker processes. The middleware is inserted before the issue creation handler and is bypassed for GET requests. 14 new tests added covering normal throughput, burst limit, TTL expiry, and multi-worker coordination. Deployed to staging: a looping agent is throttled within 3 seconds of starting. No performance regression on normal traffic.

title: UI: Issue cards overflow and truncate on viewports narrower than 768px
description: Kanban board columns overflow horizontally on mobile viewports. Priority badges and assignee names are clipped. Cards need a stacked layout below 768px with larger touch targets. Implementation is ready to start but requires the finalized mobile component spec from the design team before coding begins.
